nodes.long_description:
1. prepare the hotplate, water, beaker, clock, thermometer, and stand
2. secure the digital thermometer to the stand
3. put the water into the beaker
4. place the beaker with water on the hotplate so that the digital thermometer is submerged in the water
5. turn on the switch on the hotplate
6. press the Start button on the second hand clock
7. press the second hand at 5 minute intervals and measure the temperature of the water at each interval
8. check the temperature of the water after it boils and observe the temperature change of the water
<Result> 
The water has reached the boiling point and the temperature has remained constant. → When water vaporizes into water vapor, the temperature stays constant as it undergoes a state change - the heat energy applied is utilized to change state
nodes.short_description: Unravel the mysteries of phase changes with water as your subject. This experiment demonstrates the stages water goes through as it transitions from solid to liquid to gas, showcasing the concept of latent heat.
